claim.text:
(∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ),
    ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ →
      HasCompactSupport ψ →
        Function.support ψ ⊆ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun (X : ℝ) => (∑' (n : ℕ), f n * ψ ((↑n : ℝ) / X)) / X) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (A * ∫ (x : ℝ), ψ x))) →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n) / (↑N : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds A)

type.text:

            (nhds (A * ∫ (x : ℝ), ψ x))) →

target.text:
(∀ (s : ℂ), (1 : ℝ) < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun (n : ℕ) => (↑(f n) : ℂ)) s) →
  (∃ (G : ℂ → ℂ),
      ContinuousOn G {s : ℂ | (1 : ℝ) ≤ s.re} ∧
        ∀ (s : ℂ), (1 : ℝ) < s.re → G s = LSeries (fun (n : ℕ) => (↑(f n) : ℂ)) s - (↑A : ℂ) / (s - (1 : ℂ))) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n) / (↑N : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds A)

mathlib.doc: A function is continuously differentiable up to `n` if it admits derivatives up to order `n`, which are continuous.
mathlib.name: ContDiff

mathlib.doc: A function `f` *has compact support* or is *compactly supported* if the closure of the support of `f` is compact.
mathlib.name: HasCompactSupport

mathlib.doc: `support` of a function is the set of points `x` such that `f x ≠ 0`.
mathlib.name: Function.support

mathlib.doc: `Ioi a` is the left-open right-infinite interval $(a, ∞)$.
mathlib.name: Set.Ioi

mathlib.doc: `Filter.Tendsto` is the generic "limit of a function" predicate.
mathlib.name: Filter.Tendsto

mathlib.doc: `atTop` is the filter representing the limit `→ ∞` on an ordered set.
mathlib.name: Filter.atTop

mathlib.doc: A set is called a neighborhood of `x` if it contains an open set around `x`.
mathlib.name: nhds

mathlib.doc: `range n` is the set of natural numbers less than `n`.
mathlib.name: Finset.range
